{{Item|Blue Whale Pet}}, could grant the player upwards of {{Stat|def|80,000}}. *The ability of the '''Mastiff Armor's''' name, {{AN|Absolute Unit}}, is based on the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/absolute-unit absolute unit] meme, in which objects or animals of large size would be called an absolute unit. *Despite the name of the armor, the armor set's appearance isn't based off an actual mastiff, but rather the [[w:Shiba_Inu|Shiba Inu]] dog breed, most notably known for the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/doge Doge] meme. *Inside of dungeons, before [[Changelog/2020/November 17|Floor 7 released]], it was possible to get upwards of 100 million EHP using a [[Rarity|Rare+]] {{Item|Blue Whale Pet}} in dungeons due to each piece giving only {{Stat|Defense|-10,000}}. *Except for {{Item|Artifact of Power}}, {{Item|Relic of Power}} and {{Item|Shimmersparkle Chestplate}}, '''Mastiff Armor''' pieces are tied for having the most gemstone slots
